title: Unique-Continuation-Planar
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of every theorem, lemma and proposition of "Unique continuation on planar graphs" (Bou-Rabee, Cooperman and Ganguly): a harmonic function on a periodic plane graph with periodic conductances that is bounded by one on a set of density at least 1 - epsilon is constant (Theorem 1.1), together with the exponential upper bound (Theorem 1.2), the zero case (Theorem 1.3), the topological lemma, the exponential lower bound of the appendix with its polynomial approximation lemma and three-ball proposition, and non-planar periodic conductances on Z^2 with a harmonic function supported on a diagonal (Theorem 5.1).  Three results the paper cites from the literature (Janiszewski's theorem at a point, unicoherence of the sphere and the discrete Moser estimate) are explicit hypotheses of the theorems that use them; the classical Liouville theorem for periodic networks and the discrete Remez inequality are proved. The four main theorems are independently checked using the UCPlanarAudit/ comparator pairs.
